scope: 10 MB enwik9 validation; not a rerun of the 890 MB/1 GB benchmarks
timing_notes: Speeds use uninstrumented independent-process runs, median of three, alternating variant order.
Optimized encode GPU event times overlap CPU phases and must not be added to wall-time phases.
Probability validation remains enabled on GPU; reconstruction/SHA256/CRC checks are retained.
Model loading/warmup and external byte comparison are measured outside codec time.
